title: E-commerce Intelligence Pro Input
description: Configure how products are collected. Pass direct product URLs, category listing URLs, or a keyword search across selected marketplaces. Each product ships as one dataset row.

scrapeMode.title: Scrape mode
scrapeMode.description: Auto picks the fastest path per URL: Cheerio for static HTML pages, Playwright for JS heavy retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Target, AliExpress). Force one mode if you have a preference.
scrapeMode.sectionDescription: Use this section to configure how product data is collected. Provide direct product URLs, category listing URLs, or keywords for product searches.

productUrls.title: Product detail URLs
productUrls.description: Direct product page URLs. Mix any of the supported marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Etsy, AliExpress, Best Buy, Costco, Wayfair, Home Depot, IKEA, Zalando, ASOS, Shopify). Unknown retailers fall back to JSON-LD.

categoryUrls.title: Category listing URLs
categoryUrls.description: Category, search results, brand, or seller store URLs. The actor walks the listing, queues each product, and respects totalMaxProducts.

keyword.title: Keyword for search
keyword.description: Search term applied across each selected marketplace. Pair with marketplaces below.

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces for keyword search
marketplaces.description: Which marketplaces to run the keyword search on. Independent searches per marketplace, results merged into one dataset.

includeAdditionalProperties.title: Include additional properties
includeAdditionalProperties.description: Pull extras when present: variant matrix, ratings histogram, Q&A counts, shipping options, return policy summary, eco labels, certifications, dimensions and weight. Off keeps rows lean.

aiSummaryDataPoints.title: AI summary - data points
aiSummaryDataPoints.description: Generate per product AI summaries for the chosen aspects. Requires an OpenAI API key (set in run env). Skip for raw data only.

aiSummaryCustomPrompt.title: AI summary - custom prompt
aiSummaryCustomPrompt.description: Optional extra instruction passed to the AI summarizer. Example: 'Only mention long term durability and warranty terms'.

totalMaxProducts.title: Total maximum products
totalMaxProducts.description: Hard cap on rows pushed per run. 0 means unlimited.

searchEngine.title: Search engine
searchEngine.description: When categoryUrls is empty and keyword is set on a marketplace without a built in search, fall back to a search engine to find product URLs. Use 'none' to disable.

searchEngineCountry.title: Search engine country
searchEngineCountry.description: Country gl param. Affects which retailers Google or Bing surface.

currency.title: Output currency
currency.description: Normalize all prices to this currency in the row. Conversion uses the most recent rate at scrape time.

extractImages.title: Extract image URLs
extractImages.description: Pull primary plus gallery image URLs at original resolution.

maxImagesPerProduct.title: Max images per product
maxImagesPerProduct.description: Cap on image URLs returned. Set 0 for all.

extractVariants.title: Extract variant matrix
extractVariants.description: When the product ships in sizes, colors, or styles, return every variant with its own price, stock, and SKU.

extractRatingHistogram.title: Extract rating histogram
extractRatingHistogram.description: Pull the percentage split across 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 star reviews when the marketplace exposes it.

extractQuestionsCount.title: Extract questions count
extractQuestionsCount.description: Pull the answered questions count when present (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy).

extractShippingInfo.title: Extract shipping info
extractShippingInfo.description: Free shipping flag, delivery estimate text, in store pickup options where applicable.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip product IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Three to five is safe across retailers.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for Amazon, Walmart, Target, AliExpress. Datacenter is fine for Shopify and most other retailers.
